# cignore (linux only for now)
for when you want to gitignore everything but a couple files/folders without it being a pain

---

**building**:

```zsh
foo@bar:~$ make -B
```

**usage**:

```zsh
# using stdin
foo@bar:~$ ./ci
foo@bar:~$ enter path: main.c
foo@bar:~$ enter path: folder/
```

```zsh
# using a file (in the same format as stdin)
foo@bar:~$ ./ci .cignore
```

**example**:

### input:
```text
main.c
folder/secondfolder/file
```

### output:
```text
# generated by cignore (C) RaysOfBees

*
!folder
!folder/secondfolder
!folder/secondfolder/file
!main.c
```

---

WARNING: cannot be used on people.
